Makes the source of one 3D sound a ball instead of a point, such as a big engine or a waterfall. Together with [ListenerRadius](ListenerRadius) it makes the sound move between the speakers and change its pitch over a moment as it passes close by. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
engine = EmitSound(rumble, mothership)
ChannelRadius engine, 50
```
@param channel  A channel handle from [EmitSound](EmitSound).
@param radius  The radius in units of the world. `0` (what a channel starts with) is a point. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap A channel that is over is ignored. [GetChannelRadius](GetChannelRadius) tells the value.
